description: This file implements MCP response caching for the Superset project using FastMCP's ResponseCachingMiddleware. It includes functions to build caching settings from configuration and to create the middleware with optional Redis store backend.

methods.name: _build_caching_settings
methods.description: Builds caching settings for FastMCP ResponseCachingMiddleware based on provided cache configuration.

methods.name: create_response_caching_middleware
methods.description: Creates and returns a ResponseCachingMiddleware instance based on current Flask app configuration, with optional Redis store.
